newsitem.title: SINGAPORE: Sumitomo sees systems electronics sales up.
newsitem.headline: Sumitomo sees systems electronics sales up.

text.p: Sumitomo Electric Industries Ltd expects sales of systems electronics to grow 20 percent in its current financial year from the equivalent of about Singapore $700-S$800 million previously, director Taichiro Nagao said on Friday.
"About 20 percent increase," Nagao told Reuters after a news briefing in Singapore, when asked how much sales growth in systems electronics the company expected.

Nagao was in Singapore to sign a joint venture agreement with Singapore electronic contract manufacturer Venture Manufacturing (Singapore) Ltd to design and make system electronics products. It is Sumitomo's first joint venture in systems electronics outside Japan.
Systems electronics include systems that facilitate communications between computers and between people and computers such as personal handy phones, network products and car navigation systems.
Nagao said Sumitomo Electric had sales equivalent to about S$700-800 million from system electronics for the financial year ended March 31, 1997.
Sumitomo might move some of its systems electronics production from Osaka to its Singapore joint venture later on, he added.
The joint venture, which would invest S$20 million over four years, would start manufacturing from within Venture's facility in Singapore initially and a separate plant would be set up later.
Venture and Sumitomo expect sales of S$200 million in year 2000 from the new joint venture company, VS Electronics Lte Ltd, officials from the companies said earlier.
